description: A kind of build piece (design doc §8.3, §6.3; M3 spec claim 1). occupies: a whole build cell or one cell face. orientation restricts face pieces to vertical (walls, doors, windows) or horizontal (floors, hatches) faces. passable pieces are openings: cheap portal edges. target pieces are what raids path to. climb pieces change an actor's level (M6 spec claim 6): a climbable cell piece is climbed onto, a climbable vertical face (a ladder) up and down.
